description: This file defines the GatewayServiceResolver class, which uses NetService to resolve Bonjour (mDNS) services by hostname and port, providing asynchronous callback handling for service resolution results.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: A class that resolves Bonjour services (SRV + A/AAAA) using NetService, handling address resolution asynchronously and providing a completion callback.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the resolver with specified service name, type, domain, and a completion callback.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the service resolution with an optional timeout.

methods.name: netServiceDidResolveAddress
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when the NetService successfully resolves its address; triggers callback with resolved host and port.

methods.name: netService
methods.description: Delegate callback invoked when resolution fails; triggers callback with nil.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Handles completion by stopping the service, cleaning up, and invoking the provided completion callback.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Static helper to normalize host strings, delegating to BonjourServiceResolverSupport.
